name: tailscale-controls
title: Tailscale controls
description: The Tailscale connection as controls, over useTailscale: a "Sign in with Tailscale" button that follows the connection (sign in, signing in and cancel, connected and sign out, error and retry), a status badge (inline, stacked or a pill) with the tailnet, the error and the sign-in link when a popup is blocked, and the parts of a connection panel: TailscaleSummary (tailnet and this device) and TailscaleExitNodes, a listbox of exit nodes like macOS's Wi-Fi menu, with an EmptyState when the tailnet offers none.
